name: Wasatch Soccer Sentinel | Matt Montgomery
description:
Matt Montgomery was the managing editor of RSL Soapbox from 2012 until its closure in 2023, at which point he, along with the staff of RSL Soapbox, founded Wasatch Soccer Sentinel. He can be heard on the Real Salt Lake-focused podcast Off the Crossbar.

Matt can be found playing board games (and writing about them in his newsletter, [Don't Eat the Meeples](https://donteatthemeeples.substack.com), reading science fiction (which you can hear on the podcast [Vintage Sci-Fi Shorts](https://anchor.fm/vintage-sci-fi-shorts)), eating craft chocolate, and watching Star Trek.
